list.name: service
list.label: Service
list.description: Fixed external services. All expands to the six values for both PromQL regex and SQL string-list interpolation.

panels.title: Feed health by service
panels.description: Gaps mean missing telemetry, not a healthy feed.

panels.title: Feed freshness — age since last observation
panels.description: Seconds since the last successful feed operation. Zero or absent timestamps are unknown.

panels.title: Selected-range coverage by service
panels.description: Finalized eligible comparisons only. Holy and service totals are distinct populations for each pair, not global ingestion counts. Eligible now is independent of past outcomes. Eligible share is the fraction of observed gauge samples, not wall-clock uptime; telemetry gaps are not measured. No percentage is shown for zero denominators or missing data.

panels.title: Competitor coverage of Holy — selected range
panels.description: Each service has its own Holy population. Green is matched; holy only is the uncovered part. Bars show counts, not signed differences. Missing results remain unknown.

panels.title: Holy coverage of competitor — selected range
panels.description: Each service has its own service population. Green is matched. HolyCluster misses are split by correlated pipeline result. Pipeline gap means collection succeeded but no Holy output reached comparison; not observed means no pipeline event matched; unattributed preserves older or incomplete telemetry. Bars show counts.

targets.expr: clamp_min(sum by (service) (increase(holycluster_coverage_outcomes_total{service=~"${service:regex}",result="service_only"}[$__range])) - (sum by (service) (increase(holycluster_coverage_service_only_causes_total{service=~"${service:regex}"}[$__range])) or on (service) (0 * sum by (service) (increase(holycluster_coverage_outcomes_total{service=~"${service:regex}",result="service_only"}[$__range])))), 0)

panels.title: Directional coverage — 5-minute windows
panels.description: Competitor coverage of Holy: matched / Holy total. Holy coverage of competitor: matched / service total. Each denominator includes matched plus its own mismatch direction. Zero denominators and missing data return unknown.

panels.title: Mismatch rates — Holy only and service only
panels.description: Both directions are positive rates. Holy only means missing from the competitor; service only means missing from HolyCluster. Only finalized eligible comparisons are counted.

panels.title: Holy-only examples — bounded sample, not complete counts
panels.description: Uses the postgres-coverage datasource and bounded spot_coverage_samples table. Latest 100 retained examples in the selected finalization-time range. Sampling and retention mean these rows cannot reproduce metric totals. Frequency is shown in the stored unit.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  finalized_at AS "Finalized time",
  service AS "Service",
  spot_time AS "Spot time",
  spotter_callsign AS "Spotter",
  dx_callsign AS "DX",
  frequency AS "Frequency (stored unit)",
  comment AS "Comment"
FROM spot_coverage_samples
WHERE $__timeFilter(finalized_at)
  AND service IN (${service:sqlstring})
  AND direction = 'holy_only'
ORDER BY finalized_at DESC, service, spot_time DESC, spotter_callsign, dx_callsign, frequency
LIMIT 100

panels.title: Service-only examples — bounded sample, not complete counts
panels.description: Uses the postgres-coverage datasource and bounded spot_coverage_samples table. Latest 100 retained examples in the selected finalization-time range. Sampling and retention mean these rows cannot reproduce metric totals. Frequency is shown in the stored unit.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  finalized_at AS "Finalized time",
  service AS "Service",
  spot_time AS "Spot time",
  spotter_callsign AS "Spotter",
  dx_callsign AS "DX",
  frequency AS "Frequency (stored unit)",
  comment AS "Comment"
FROM spot_coverage_samples
WHERE $__timeFilter(finalized_at)
  AND service IN (${service:sqlstring})
  AND direction = 'service_only'
ORDER BY finalized_at DESC, service, spot_time DESC, spotter_callsign, dx_callsign, frequency
LIMIT 100

panels.title: Matched and population rates
panels.description: Holy total = matched + Holy only; service total = matched + service only. Population totals overlap at matched. Do not add the lines.

panels.title: Skipped comparisons by service and reason
panels.description: Skipped comparisons are excluded from the outcome counts and coverage denominators. They are not mismatches.

panels.title: Parse failures by service
panels.description: Parse error rate. The metric contract has no separate general-error counter; feed health and skipped reasons show other failures.
